profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Qualcomm
profile.summary:
•Software engineer in the field of mobile handset and multimedia communication software for the embedded system 
•Strong knowledge in embedded system and Real Time OS
•Device Driver and OS kernel development
•Expert in multimedia s/w such as video, image, audio codecs and image / video signal processing
•Familiar with Arm processor architecture
•Fluent in the program languages of C, C++ , Java and Arm Assembly
•Broad experience in design, coding and debugging skills
